nodes.description: Expanded polyglutamine ataxin-1, ataxin-2, and TBP adopt aberrant conformations and form nuclear and cytoplasmic inclusions. Sequestration of chaperones, ubiquitin-proteasome and autophagy components, and interacting partners progressively impairs neuronal proteostasis, contributing to Purkinje-cell and brainstem-neuron dysfunction. nodes.description: ELOVL4 (SCA34) encodes the elongase that makes very-long-chain fatty acids. Dominant ELOVL4 variants cause a progressive ataxia in which cerebellar atrophy is essentially universal on imaging, classically accompanied by erythrokeratoderma, although the skin lesion is present in only a minority of reported cases. Other ELOVL4 alleles instead cause a retinal maculopathy, so the tissue affected depends on the allele.
